title: Mind lamp turns green during the episode

tellings.quote: So, when you multiply these probabilities, you get a 2% chance that we got green on the first try within the first 30 seconds of trying.

plain: During a 2021 episode filmed in Princeton, New Jersey, the people on the show tried to make a "mind lamp" turn green, and it did so on the first try, within the first 30 seconds. Michels describes this himself, citing a researcher named Herb Metts, in an episode about the CIA's program to use psychics as spies. Michels works out the odds as a 2% chance of that happening by luck, which would point to the mind having some effect on the lamp.
